period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), compared against the prior period-end position. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January of the same year, as published in the bank's own 'Un-audited Balance Sheet' and 'Un-audited Profit and Loss Account' for the period ended 31 March 2026. SOLO/STANDALONE basis (header reads 'Mercantile Bank PLC.' / 'Mercantile Bank Limited' Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account with no 'and its Subsidiaries'/'Consolidated' qualifier; the same source PDF also contains an earlier CONSOLIDATED Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Account section headed 'Mercantile Bank PLC. and its Subsidiaries', which was correctly identified and NOT used, consistent with this bank's established SOLO reporting_basis). SOURCE PDF WAS A SCANNED IMAGE (0 lines extractable via pdftotext) -- recovered via OCR: rendered to PNG with pdftoppm at 250 DPI, then run through tesseract (--psm 6). Every balance-sheet and P&L subtotal was manually cross-checked against every internal arithmetic identity before being trusted -- balance-sheet identity (Total Assets = sum of 8 asset lines = Total Liabilities + Total Equity), Total Liabilities composition (Borrowings + Subordinated Bond + Perpetual Bond + Deposits + Other Liabilities), the full operating-income chain (Net Interest Income + Investment Income + Commission/Exchange/Brokerage + Other Operating Income = Total Operating Income), the expense/provision/tax/net-profit chain, the appropriation chain (Net Profit + Retained Surplus b/f = Appropriations + Retained Surplus c/f, cross-tied to the Balance Sheet's own Surplus-in-P&L line), Off-Balance-Sheet composition, and EPS (Net Profit / (Paid-up Capital / 10 par value)). This redundant-arithmetic approach caught and corrected specific OCR digit-substitution errors (documented per-period below) before any figure was accepted into this dataset; periods where a figure could not be confidently resolved this way were left as reported without forcing a correction. The source PDF was served truncated/damaged by mblbd.com (matching this bank's known download-layer-truncation pattern) and was only partially recovered via qpdf --replace-input (17 of an original ~21 pages; some sub-line detail lost within recovered pages, e.g. 'Non-convertible Subordinated Bond' line, 'Deposit under schemes' value, and 'Foreign currency translation' value all blank). 'Non-banking assets' read as 4,010,150,332 (raw OCR, and wildly inconsistent with the constant 45,081,332 seen in every prior quarter back to 2023), corrected to 1,010,150,332 -- Total Assets ties out exactly only with the corrected value (the raw reading overstated the total by exactly 3,000,000,000, the same leading '1' misread as '4' pattern seen elsewhere in this corpus); 1,010,150,332 is itself a large, genuine jump from the historical 45,081,332 baseline, consistent with growing foreclosed/repossessed collateral amid this bank's documented asset-quality stress. Subordinated Bond is treated as 0 (blank in the OCR, consistent with full redemption already evidenced in quarterly/2025_Q3.json) -- Total Liabilities ties out exactly on this basis. Total shareholders' Equity (26,868,895,556) is confirmed via the balance-sheet identity (Total Liabilities + Equity = Total Assets, exact) despite a blank 'Foreign currency translation' sub-line (algebraically implied at ~17,267,040, in line with the 15-17m range seen in adjacent quarters, but not needed for or used in this dataset's line items).
